einzeiler: Serena and Venus Williams return at the US Open as singles action intensifies.
kurzfassung: The podcast reviews a dramatic night at Flushing Meadows featuring the doubles match of Serena and Venus Williams. It also covers key singles victories and struggles for top contenders like Aryna Sabalenka, Carlos Alcaraz, and Jessica Pegula. Additionally, the hosts preview the upcoming fourth-round matchups and discuss the tournament's late-night scheduling records.
stichpunkte: Serena and Venus Williams played their first-round doubles match in front of a packed and loud Arthur Ashe Stadium crowd, ultimately losing in a deciding set tie-break.
Caroline Wozniacki allegedly leaked that Serena Williams plans to return to singles competition in 2027.
Aryna Sabalenka defeated Kamila Rakhimova in straight sets while complaining about marijuana smoke near the court and prepares to face Taylor Townsend.
Taylor Townsend secured a thrilling three-set victory over Diana Shnaider after a high-quality battle.
Jessica Pegula overcame a slow start and a first-set loss against Leylah Fernandez to reach the fourth round.
Carlos Alcaraz defeated Wu Yibing in straight sets while sporting a compression vest and discussed finding his rhythm after a lengthy layoff.
Daniil Medvedev cruised past Arthur Rinderknech in straight sets, earning high marks from the hosts for his consistent form.
Alex Michelson advanced by defeating Daniel Merida and spoke candidly about his past lack of physical training and recent improvements.
Ben Shelton battled past Denis Shapovalov in a late-night match that pushed the US Open record for 2 AM finishes.

clips.text: An evaluation of how Jessica Pegula matches up against her next opponent following a hard-fought previous encounter.

clips.hook: Alex Michelson's honest admission about his past physical preparation
clips.text: Alex Michelson's candid revelation that he avoided gym work and physical conditioning for most of his early career until recently.

clips.hook: Setting a new US Open record for late finishes
clips.text: The hosts highlight a new tournament record for the number of matches concluding past 2 AM while pointing out the remaining days left.

beschreibung:
Catherine Whitaker, David Law and Matt Roberts are together at Flushing Meadows on the night that Serena and Venus Williams returned to the Arthur Ashe Stadium.
Part one - We discuss the Williams sisters’ loss to Maya Joint and Chan Hao Ching, the incredible sense of occasion, and what could be next for Serena. In the singles, there’s chat about Taylor Townsend setting up at a tantalising clash with Aryna Sabalenka, Jessica Pegula overcoming a sluggish start to beat Leylah Fernandez, and a couple of surprising losses for Elina Svitolina and Karolina Muchova.
Part two (25:27) - We cover another win for Carlos Alcaraz, his amusing outfit adjustment, Daniil Medvedev’s convincing form ahead of a fourth round match against Frances Tiafoe, and why Alex Michelsen feels like there’s still so much more to come from him.
Part three (44:42) - Reaction to Ben Shelton’s victory over Denis Shapovalov in another match which finished at gone 2am and a look ahead to Saturday’s order of play.
